answer: Give every identity its own version of the work. The beacon salts each agent's task with private numbers: one persona estimates ocean freight delays at a given wharf, another tallies a raven survey log, each with figures nobody else sees. A farm can't solve once and paste across 300 accounts; it pays full compute per persona. A reply that fits another identity's figures proves copying and freezes that cluster's stake for jury review, while checking stays cheap: recompute from the salt.
